title: Critique: the meta-problem is the neutral form of the illusion problem

statements.text: The meta-problem, explaining why people think consciousness poses a hard problem, subsumes the illusion problem while staying neutral on whether consciousness exists. The illusion problem presupposes a very strong view held by a small minority, so the wider field is better served by working on the meta-problem.

sources.quote: the problem of explaining why we think that there is a problem of consciousness
In effect, the meta-problem subsumes the illusion problem while being more general and more neutral.
